_comment: Hand-patched ability blocks for monsters whose HTML tables are corrupt in the
upstream SRD markdown (cell boundaries are misaligned, e.g. '+10 +10'
and 'CON 29'). Values were read directly from the raw table text and
cross-checked: for every entry below, mod == floor((score - 10) / 2). The
converter re-verifies that invariant at build time and fails loudly if an
Will-o'-Wisp's STR score is absent from the source entirely - only the mod and
save (-5, -5) survive. STR 1 is the score that produces a -5 modifier.
A tolerant heuristic parser was considered and rejected: the corruption pattern
duplicates values ('CON 29 CON 29 +9 +9'), and any rule general enough to
recover that would also silently mangle correct blocks. A wrong Ancient Red
Dragon at the table is worse than a loud failure.
